notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
Update 1.2.0 is here!

- Slightly nerfed the level 3 boss's HP
- Decreased the amount of missiles that the level 3 boss shoots
- Nerfed the RD wasp's HP
- Buffed all level 3 minibosses' HP
- Buffed the level 4 boss
- Improved the 3d on the car in level 3
- Made the game icon sharper
- Made the city background less repetitive
- Internal optimizations (Removing unused code/assets, compressing sound effects)
- Changed the "Close game" button in the pause screen to "Back to title"
- Moved the ending roll text to the center of the screen
- Fixed music playing when tabbed out of cutscenes (the game would pause, thus desyncing the music)
- Fixed some visual mistakes in the cast roll
- Removed Ctrl + R reset hotkey
- Volume slider turns red when clicked
- Added gradients in the prologue art backgrounds
- Added password in the pause menu
- Removed the pumpkin, for real this time

Enjoy.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
- Anti-piracy system added
- Extended the level 3 time to 3 minutes
- Buffed the level 3 boss
- Buffed both helicopters in level 3
- Nerfed the level 3 speed tank
- Removed the jack o' lantern at the start of the game

Enjoy.

notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0 is here! Here is what it adds/changes:

- Fixed being able to jump on top of the last train car in level 2
- Fixed being able to press 'F' to change the inbetween-level graphic
- Added highscore saving (press the 'delete' key on the title screen or settings screen to unload highscore, will be 0 on the next startup of the game)
- Added a Jack o' Lantern at the start
- Added more billboard details in level 4
- You can now see the current password at the game over screen
- Buffed the final phase of the final boss (volatile small wasps spawn from both holes)
- Added more frames to Project Omicron's animation

Enjoy!
